error: Request not confirmed. Check configuration and refresh history before retrying a generation.
unconfigured: No text provider is configured. Set up a writing provider or a text-capable Studio binding first.
sent: Generation requested. Refresh history to see its result; the page has not changed.
saved: Reviewed change saved. Public preview is reloading.
empty: No text candidates for this page yet.
native: Saved writing provider · generation not verified
conflict: The saved page changed. Your proposal remains here. Reload the saved page and review again before applying.
forbidden: Your current permissions do not allow this action.
oversize: This page exceeds the assistant context limit. Open the editor to work on a smaller section.
selection: Select a nonempty passage that occurs exactly once in the saved body.
builder: This page uses the page builder. Edit its layout/body in the native builder; title and excerpt remain available here.
title: Title
question_task: Answer the user question about the supplied saved page. Do not claim to change or publish it.
edit_task: Propose replacement text only for this field, preserving the supplied page facts. Do not claim to apply it:
pending_close: Wait for this request to finish before closing.
intro: Uses the saved page, not unsaved work in another editor. Nothing is sent to a provider until you review and confirm the request.
question: Ask a question
consent_help: Review the destination and page context below. This may send your saved content to the selected external provider and incur its charges.
consent: I reviewed this destination and request.
history_help: Includes this page’s Studio text candidates for your account. Refresh reads saved results; it does not launch another generation.
review_change: Compare and apply an explicit change
published: This page is published. Applying a change updates the public page immediately.
select_portion: Use selected passage from current text
apply_consent: I reviewed the original and replacement and want to save this change.
reload: Reload saved page and discard this proposal
